meta.title: LordOS — the free, fast and secure Linux desktop
meta.description: LordOS is a free GNU/Linux distribution based on Debian with its own desktop environment, display server and Wayland compositor, built on solid Debian and Wayland foundations. Private by design. Runs on 64-bit PCs (amd64) and on the Raspberry Pi 5 (arm64).
meta.galleryDescription: Real screenshots of LordOS, the free GNU/Linux distribution based on Debian with a desktop environment of its own. No mockups, no retouching.

heroTitle: The free, fast and secure Linux desktop.
heroLead: LordOS is a free GNU/Linux distribution based on Debian with its own desktop environment, display server and Wayland compositor written in C, its own interface engine, and native apps made to feel calm, clear and private.
altDesktop: The LordOS desktop with the Dock, the menu bar and the About window
featTitle: Everything you need. Nothing you don’t.
featLead: A complete desktop with native apps, privacy built in, and the Linux apps you already use.
features: Its own display server and Wayland compositor in C and its own interface engine, on a solid Debian base. Smooth on any 64-bit PC (amd64), and light enough for the Raspberry Pi 5 (arm64).
Installable LordOS apps run isolated and ask before using your camera, microphone, files or network. You decide.
Watch every connection on a live world map, then allow or block it per app, or turn on blocklists of ad, tracker and malware sites.
A vault for passwords, 2FA codes and cards that unlocks with a password or a USB key.
Native apps for your accounts, with remote images blocked until you say so.
Chromium, Firefox and GTK apps fit right in, with the same window frame and dark mode.
showcase: CPU, memory, network, disks and now cooling: live temperatures, fan curves and a full-speed button for heavy work.
Monitor showing the Cooling tab with the fan curve
Categories, tags, a strong password generator and 2FA codes. The window is hidden from screenshots and screen sharing.
The Passwords app with an entry open
Dark mode, accent colors, the Dock on any side, displays, Bluetooth, energy and remote desktop, all in one place.
dlLead: Pay what you want, including nothing. Your support keeps LordOS free for everyone.
isoText: Live and installable ISO for computers with an x86-64 processor. Try it without installing.
piText: A ready-to-flash image for SD card or NVMe, with fan control and our own kernel.
debText: Add LordOS to the system you already have, on a PC or a server (VPS), with one command:
imgText: Write LordOS to an SD card or a USB stick from the computer you already have, and set up the Raspberry Pi 5's first boot: its name, your account, Wi-Fi, remote access, appearance and cooling. Every official image is checked against the release signature before anything is erased.
imgNote: It also comes with LordOS (App Launcher → System). Free and open source, it collects nothing.
dlNote: Downloads are published on GitHub Releases with SHA-256 checksums.
verifyText: Every release is signed with the LordOS release key. Check the signature before you install. Key fingerprint (SHA-256):
supLead: LordOS is free and open source. If it makes your computer better, help us keep building it.
payNote: With Mercado Pago you choose the amount on the next page.
lumoText: Lumo is a small celestial fox with white fur and violet highlights. Its crown and cape stand for protection, freedom and control, and it shows up when something needs your attention.
aboutLead: LordOS is created by the iPERFEX group, by Pablo Miranda and Federico Pereira.
footer: © 2026 iPERFEX · Pablo Miranda and Federico Pereira. LordOS is free software under the MIT license.
